description: Mobile-first UI + env/docs. Installs maplibre-gl; builds RouteMap, ElevationProfile, and RouteSummary components; the standalone /routes page with RouteSuggester and nav entries; the Settings home-location editor; a barrel export (components/routes/index.ts) that is the documented Phase-6 plan hook; and the ORS env/Docker/README wiring. Depends on FEAT-002 (the /api/routes/suggest + /api/profile/home-location endpoints) and FEAT-001 (RouteResult shape).
steps: Install maplibre-gl on the HOST: cd /Users/pascal.fongkye/Documents/ws/sportai/.worktrees/route-suggestions/app && npm install maplibre-gl (it ships its own types; no @types needed). This updates package.json + package-lock.json.

Create app/src/components/routes/route-map.tsx ('use client'): import 'maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css'; build the map with a keyless OSM raster-tile style defined inline from a SINGLE swappable module constant (e.g. OSM_RASTER_STYLE) — NOT the ORS key; accept a GeoJSON LineString + bbox; addSource/addLayer for the line; map.fitBounds(bbox); enable touch pan/zoom; container has an explicit bounded height (or it renders 0px). Clean up the map instance on unmount. Callers load it via next/dynamic ssr:false (it touches window/WebGL).

Create app/src/components/routes/elevation-profile.tsx ('use client' if it uses hooks, else a plain component): a small inline SVG chart from elevationProfile ({distM,eleM}[]) with no heavy chart dep; labelled axes/min-max; include an SR-only text summary. No hover-only affordances (gotcha #23).

Create app/src/components/routes/route-summary.tsx: presentational honest summary (actual vs requested distance, ascent/descent, terrain label, startLabel, optional note). Reused by the page AND exported for the plan hook. Doubles as the map's SR alternative.

Create app/src/app/(app)/routes/page.tsx (server shell + metadata) rendering a client RouteSuggester (app/src/components/routes/route-suggester.tsx). Controls: distance (number/slider), flat vs uphill (segmented), location source (use-my-location via navigator.geolocation -> fromGeolocation, home, type-a-place) — touch-friendly, labelled, keyboard-operable, no hover-only. POST /api/routes/suggest via http() (gotcha #18). Render dynamically-imported RouteMap (ssr:false) + ElevationProfile + RouteSummary. Graceful geolocation denial -> fall back to home/place. Mobile-first single column; map in a bounded card; no horizontal scroll. AVOID synchronous setState in useEffect (derive via useState(()=>...) or set in a .then — see strava-settings.tsx).
Add a /routes nav entry to BOTH app/src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx and app/src/components/layout/mobile-nav.tsx (label e.g. 'Routes', an inline SVG icon matching the existing style).

Create app/src/components/routes/home-location-editor.tsx ('use client'): use-my-location (navigator.geolocation -> fromGeolocation) or type-a-place -> PATCH /api/profile/home-location via http(); accessible, mobile-first, no hover-only controls. Wire it into app/src/app/(app)/settings/page.tsx: server-load current home_lat/home_lng/home_label from profiles and pass as props (mirror how StravaSettings receives initialConnection); add it under an 'Preferences' or 'Location' section.

Create app/src/components/routes/index.ts barrel exporting RouteMap, ElevationProfile, RouteSummary with a top-of-file doc comment: the training-plan-generation plan view imports these (one-way dependency plan -> route) and attaches a route to a long-run session via POST /api/routes/suggest with plannedSessionId + the session's target_distance_m. State clearly that the /plan view is currently a stub (app/src/app/(app)/plan/page.tsx) with no session card, so this is the documented leave-behind only — nothing is wired into /plan now (Phase 6 skipped except this hook).

Env/Docker/README wiring (Phase 7): app/.env.local.example — under 'External APIs' add ORS_API_KEY=your-openrouteservice-api-key + commented # ORS_BASE_URL=https://api.openrouteservice.org with signup link https://openrouteservice.org/dev/#/signup. docker/docker-compose.yml app service 'environment:' block — add ORS_API_KEY: ${ORS_API_KEY} and ORS_BASE_URL: ${ORS_BASE_URL:-https://api.openrouteservice.org} (app-side vars, NOT docker/.env; do NOT touch running containers). README.md — add a short 'Suggested routes (ORS)' setup note (get a key, set ORS_API_KEY; mention the in-container install caveat gotcha #16 for Docker) + a Troubleshooting entry (missing key -> ORS_UNAUTHORIZED -> set ORS_API_KEY).

Run npx eslint on EVERY new client component (route-map, elevation-profile, route-suggester, home-location-editor, route-summary if client) — build does NOT catch react-hooks/set-state-in-effect (gotcha #28).

cd app && npm run build passes; npx eslint on each new client component is clean.

=== maplibre-gl IMPORT GOTCHA ===
maplibre-gl v6 has NO default export — `import maplibregl from 'maplibre-gl'` fails the Turbopack build ('Export default doesn't exist'). Use a NAMESPACE import: `import * as maplibregl from 'maplibre-gl'`. (Added to package.json as ^6.15.0 + lockfile; host install only — for Docker it still needs an in-container install per gotcha #16, noted in README.)

=== INTEGRATION NOTES FOR THE PLAN FEATURE (Phase 6, deferred) ===
Import the presentational pieces from '@/components/routes' (RouteSummary, ElevationProfile) and load RouteMap via next/dynamic(() => import('@/components/routes/route-map'), { ssr:false }). The RouteResult shape consumed by these is the POST /api/routes/suggest success body `route` (FEAT-001/002). To attach a route to a long-run session, POST /api/routes/suggest with { distanceKm: session.target_distance_m/1000, terrain, plannedSessionId: session.id }. /plan page remains the untouched stub. NOTE: migration 014 (home_lat/home_lng/home_label on profiles + suggested_routes) must be applied MANUALLY (gotcha #4) before the Routes page/home-location editor work against a real DB — build does not require it (types are hand-maintained).
